# Translate Text

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Translates the given text from one language to another.

## Syntax

~~~~text
translateText(text: <#String (Allows Variables)#>, from: <#Enumeration (WFSelectedFromLanguage) (Optional)#>, to: <#Enumeration (WFSelectedLanguage)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
translateText(text: "Hello World", from: English, to: Japanese)
~~~~
